data.description:
## Knowledge Needed
- Read: cortical/spark/ngram.py (current train() implementation)
- Understand: count accumulation at lines 106-108
- Understand: probability calculation with Laplace smoothing

## Implementation
Extend NGramModel with:
1. train_weighted(documents, weights) method
2. train_on_tokens_weighted(token_lists, weights) method
3. Allow fractional count accumulation: count += weight instead of count += 1
4. Update total_documents and total_tokens to accept floats

## Guardrails
- DO: Preserve backward compatibility (existing train() unchanged)
- DO: Add new methods rather than modifying existing signatures
- DO: Ensure probabilities still sum correctly with weighted counts
- DO NOT: Break existing tests
- DO NOT: Change the smoothing formula semantics
- EXPLORE: Whether to store weights separately for debugging
- EXPLORE: Weighted finalize() for frequency cache

## Success Criteria
- train_weighted() produces valid probability distributions
- Existing tests still pass
- New weighted tests demonstrate correct behavior
- perplexity() works with weighted models
data.title: Add weighted training support to NGramModel
